label: S360 - Hub & Node Mgmt

Gestión de Hubs (HUB_ONLINE) y Nodos (CRUD + envío de config vía MQTT).

Tópicos MQTT:
- Escucha: seguimiento360/hub/status
- Publica: seguimiento360/tenant/{tid}/site/{sid}/hub/{mac}/node_cfg

Endpoints REST:
- GET    /api/nodes?hub_id=X
- POST   /api/nodes
- PUT    /api/nodes/:id
- DELETE /api/nodes/:id

label: S360 - Portal API & Eventos
info:
Persistencia de eventos en PostgreSQL y APIs de consulta para el portal web multiusuario.

Endpoints:
- GET /api/events (filtros: site_id, node_mac, event_type, from, to, limit, offset)
- GET /api/overview (sitios + hubs + nodos del tenant)

query:
WITH ev AS (
  INSERT INTO events (tenant_id, site_id, hub_id, hub_mac, node_mac, node_name,
                      event_type, battery_level, value, sequence_number, payload)
  VALUES ($1, $2, (SELECT id FROM hubs WHERE serial_number = $3), $3, $4, COALESCE($5, (SELECT name FROM nodes WHERE lower(mac_address) = lower($4))), $6, $7, $8, $9, $10::jsonb)
  RETURNING node_mac, event_type
)
/* El evento es la unica prueba de vida que manda el nodo. Aqui, y no en el
 * endpoint de edicion, se corta el hilo de 'sin senales'. El hub escribe la mac
 * en mayusculas y la base la guarda en minusculas, de ahi el lower() a los dos
 * lados: sin eso el UPDATE no casaba ni una fila.
 *
 * NODE_LOST viene por este mismo topic y NO es un contacto: es el hub diciendo
 * que el nodo lleva 30 min mudo. Si contara como vida, el aviso dejaria al nodo
 * 'active' y 'visto ahora', que es la mentira justa al reves. */
UPDATE nodes n
SET last_seen = CASE WHEN ev.event_type = 'NODE_LOST' THEN n.last_seen ELSE NOW() END,
    status    = CASE WHEN ev.event_type = 'NODE_LOST' THEN 'inactive' ELSE 'active' END,
    updated_at = NOW()
FROM ev
WHERE lower(n.mac_address) = lower(ev.node_mac);

SELECT overview
query:
SELECT COALESCE(s.id, 0) AS site_id,
       COALESCE(s.name, 'Sin sitio asignado') AS site_name,
       h.id AS hub_id, h.name AS hub_name, h.serial_number AS hub_mac,
       h.status AS hub_status, h.last_seen AS hub_last_seen,
       COALESCE(ast.state, 'disarmed') AS alarm_state,
       d.device_type,
       n.id AS node_id, n.mac_address AS node_mac, n.name AS node_name,
       n.location, n.room, n.distance_threshold, n.status AS node_status,
       n.last_seen AS node_last_seen,
       le.event_type AS last_event_type, le.value AS last_value
FROM hubs h
LEFT JOIN sites s ON s.id = h.site_id AND s.tenant_id = h.tenant_id
LEFT JOIN alarm_state ast ON ast.hub_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN nodes n ON n.hub_id = h.id
LEFT JOIN devices d ON lower(d.serial_number) = lower(n.mac_address)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.event_type, e.value
  FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
) le ON true
WHERE h.tenant_id = $1
ORDER BY site_name, hub_name, node_name;

SELECT salud del nodo
query:
SELECT n.id, n.mac_address, n.name, n.status, n.last_seen, n.distance_threshold,
       h.serial_number AS hub_serial, h.name AS hub_name, d.device_type,
       h.status AS hub_status, h.last_seen AS hub_last_seen,
       u.created_at AS ultimo_evento, u.event_type AS ultimo_tipo,
       u.battery_level AS bateria, u.value AS distancia,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS eventos_24h,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '1 hour') AS eventos_1h,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
          AND e.value = 0) AS ceros_24h,
       /* 254 y 255 son codigos del firmware, no distancias: no pueden contar
        * como lecturas utiles. */
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
          AND e.value BETWEEN 1 AND 253) AS medidas_24h,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
          AND e.value = 255) AS sin_eco_24h,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
          AND e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'
          AND e.value = 254) AS fuera_rango_24h
FROM nodes n
JOIN hubs h ON h.id = n.hub_id
LEFT JOIN devices d ON lower(d.serial_number) = lower(n.mac_address)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT e.created_at, e.event_type, e.battery_level, e.value, e.sequence_number
  FROM events e WHERE e.node_mac = n.mac_address
  ORDER BY e.created_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT 1
) u ON true
WHERE n.id = $1 AND h.tenant_id = $2;
